A1.scope: Catalog revision 1 payload; link list only, no content.
A1.statement: Catalog revision 1 lists doc:calibration@1 ('Kalibrovka i predely priborov') among its links.

A2.scope: Catalog revision 1 payload; link list only, no content.
A2.statement: Catalog revision 1 lists doc:references@1 ('Spravochnye otkliki materialov') among its links.

A3.scope: Catalog revision 1 payload; link list only, no content.
A3.statement: Catalog revision 1 lists doc:model-M7@1 ('Tipovoe opisanie modeli M7') among its links.

A4.scope: Candidate relevance only: S17 carries external marking M7; document title mentions model M7. Not verified as the same object or construction.
A4.statement: Hypothesis: doc:model-M7@1 may describe the object whose external marking is M7 on sample S17, since both reference 'M7'; the mark-to-model link is not yet established.

A5.scope: Typical (standard) version of the article as described in document revision 1; no sample-level verification.
A5.statement: doc:model-M7@1 states that in the typical version the external coating of the article is made of P-A.

A6.scope: Described example of use (ekspluatatsiya) in document revision 1, not a measurement of S17.
A6.statement: doc:model-M7@1 states that in its described example of operation the article is in dry air.

A7.scope: Document subject field only; the document describes the product model, not a specific serial or batch.
A7.statement: The subject of doc:model-M7@1 is the product model M7 (model:M7); the document carries no serial numbers and no batches.

A8.scope: Inference from the external marking M7 only; the document's own scope note says S17 and its actual conditions are not stated, and it reports no internal structure.
A8.statement: Hypothesis (refined): model:M7's typical description (external coating P-A, dry-air example) may apply to S17 because of its external marking M7, but S17 is never named in the document, so the mark-to-model link stays unverified.

A9.scope: Reference table conditions only; S17 is not named there and no measurement of S17 exists yet.
A9.statement: doc:references@1 reports its reference responses at 20 C over five channels q1..q5, and states the set is an open set of standards rather than all materials.

A10.scope: Document revision 1 reference table at 20 C; a table value, not a measurement of any sample.
A10.statement: doc:references@1 lists polymer P-A with reference response [0.1, 0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 0.2] in channels q1..q5 at 20 C.

A11.scope: Document revision 1 reference table at 20 C; a table value, not a measurement of any sample.
A11.statement: doc:references@1 lists polymer P-B with reference response [0.1, 0.1, 0.8, 0.3, 0.2] in channels q1..q5 at 20 C.

A12.scope: Doc:references@1 revision 1, five given channels at 20 C; equality of listed vectors only, no statement about composition or other methods.
A12.statement: Hypothesis: within doc:references@1 at 20 C the listed responses of P-A and P-B are identical, so this reference set alone cannot distinguish them by these five channels.

A13.scope: Document revision 1 reference table at 20 C; the listed standards closest to a distinct, non-polymer pattern.
A13.statement: doc:references@1 lists quartz glass (standard G) as [0.9, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05] and oxide additive GeO2 (standard X) as [0.4, 0.8, 0.3, 0.3, 0.1] at 20 C.

A14.scope: Declared properties of this training fixture's conditional instruments, document revision 1; resolution values are abstract 'units', not tied to mm or um.
A14.statement: doc:calibration@1 declares for radial_profile a contrast repeatability of 1 unit and a resolvable step of 5 units, and states that a boundary is localized only between adjacent sampled coordinates.

A15.scope: Mock-instrument assumption stated in document revision 1; explicitly labelled a fixture convention, not a real spectroscopy law; reference library declared incomplete.
A15.statement: doc:calibration@1 sets material_response absolute tolerance 0.001 per channel, assumes a mixture's response equals the mass-fraction sum of component responses, warns that response coincidence does not establish uniqueness of composition, and declares reference_library_complete = false.

A16.scope: Declared pulse_trace contract in document revision 1; internal propagation is by definition unobserved.
A16.statement: doc:calibration@1 states pulse_trace records only input and output times on common ideal clocks, unit ns, resolution 0.001 ns, and that the impulse path inside the sample is not observed.

A17.scope: Overview frame at state-0, 20 C, manual frame annotation; only the external outline is resolved.
A17.statement: Overview observation of S17 at 20 C reports label 'S17 / M7', length 1000 mm, and an external outline radius interval 124.9-125.1 um; smaller radial inhomogeneities are not resolved.

A18.scope: Single overview frame at state-0; the cell is seen around a section of S17 only.
A18.statement: Overview observation shows a transparent cell V04 around the corresponding section of S17 at 20 C, with a settable temperature capability of 20-40 C.

A19.scope: Overview frame only: visual contact and a declared material_response capability; no reading of U09 taken yet.
A19.statement: Overview observation shows transparent contents U09 of cell V04 touching S17, and declares material_response as the only observe method available for U09.

A20.scope: Hypothesis from a single overview frame plus a document example; U09 is unnamed and unmeasured, and dry air is only the document's described example.
A20.statement: Hypothesis: the immediate medium contacting S17 in the fixture is U09 rather than the 'dry air' of doc:model-M7@1's example, and U09's identity must be settled by its own material_response.

A21.scope: Single radial_profile scan at x=0, state-0, 20 C, discrete coordinates 0..150 um; boundaries only localizable between adjacent samples; no axial symmetry or continuity measured.
A21.statement: radial_profile of S17 at x=0 returns r_um [0, 2, 3.9, 4.1, 20, 62.4, 62.6, 90, 124.9, 125.1, 150] with contrast_units [100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 160, 160, 160, 160, 20, 20], i.e. contrast 100 out to at least r=20 um, 160 from r=62.4 to 125.1 um, 20 at r=150 um.

A22.scope: Localization limited by the sampling grid (resolvable step 5 units, boundary only between neighbouring coordinates); the 125.1->150 transition lies at the sample outline, not inside it.
A22.statement: At x=0 the profile contains a step from contrast 100 to 160 only between r=20 and r=62.4 um, and a drop from 160 to 20 only between r=125.1 and r=150 um, the latter at the external surface reported as 124.9-125.1 um in the overview.

A23.scope: Interpretation of one section only; region radii are bounded by the sampled coordinates, the radial position of the inner boundary is unresolved within 20-62.4 um, and materials of both zones are unknown.
A23.statement: Hypothesis: the x=0 cross-section is separable into an inner contrast-100 zone (r <~20-62 um) and an outer contrast-160 zone (from there out to the ~125 um surface), i.e. at least one internal radial boundary exists at that section.

A24.scope: Combines an observation with the unverified mark-to-model link A8; no material_response of S17 has been taken and the document never names S17.
A24.statement: Hypothesis: if S17 follows doc:model-M7@1's P-A external coating claim, the outer contrast-160 zone at x=0 is where a P-A-like coating would be sampled, e.g. by material_response at r=90 um.

A25.scope: One material_response reading at x=0 mm, r=90 um, state-0, 20 C, channels q1..q5 per doc:calibration@1; single averaged spot, no spatial distribution resolved.
A25.statement: material_response of S17 at x=0, r=90 um (the contrast-160 outer zone) returns [0.9, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05] over q1..q5 at 20 C.

A26.scope: One S17 reading vs doc:references@1 revision 1 table at 20 C; doc:calibration@1 declares reference_library_complete = false and that coincident responses do not establish uniqueness of composition.
A26.statement: Hypothesis: the outer-zone reading at x=0, r=90 um coincides within the declared 0.001/channel tolerance with quartz-glass standard G, so under this method the outer zone is glass-like rather than P-A-like, though the incomplete reference set forbids calling it quartz glass.

A27.scope: Doc:model-M7@1 revision 1 typical-version claim plus one S17 reading; mark-to-model link A8 stays unverified and the inner zone is unmeasured.
A27.statement: Hypothesis (revised): the outer contrast-160 zone at x=0 is not sampling P-A-like material, since its r=90 um response matches the glass standard instead; the P-A external-coating claim of doc:model-M7@1 is unsupported at this location.

A28.scope: One material_response reading at x=0 mm, r=2 um, state-0, 20 C, channels q1..q5 per doc:calibration@1; single averaged spot near the axis, no spatial distribution resolved.
A28.statement: material_response of S17 at x=0, r=2 um (the contrast-100 inner zone) returns [0.9, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.05] over q1..q5 at 20 C.

A29.scope: Two S17 readings vs doc:references@1 revision 1 table at 20 C; doc:calibration@1 declares reference_library_complete = false and that response coincidence does not establish uniqueness of composition.
A29.statement: Hypothesis: the inner-zone reading at x=0, r=2 um is numerically identical to the outer-zone reading at r=90 um and to quartz-glass standard G, so under this method the inner zone is glass-like too, not P-A-like.

A30.scope: Interpretation from one section (x=0) and two sampled radii at 20 C only; the contrast step itself is a real reading difference (100 vs 160) and no axial continuity was measured.
A30.statement: Hypothesis: at x=0 the contrast step 100->160 is not accompanied by any material_response difference between the two zones, so the contrast boundary is not shown to be a composition boundary by this method.

A31.scope: Single radial_profile scan at x=500 mm, state-0, 20 C, discrete coordinates 0..150 um; boundaries localizable only between adjacent samples; no axial continuity measured.
A31.statement: radial_profile of S17 at x=500 mm returns r_um [0, 2, 3.9, 4.1, 20, 62.4, 62.6, 90, 124.9, 125.1, 150] with contrast_units [100, 100, 100, 100, 100, 160, 160, 160, 160, 20, 20], numerically identical to the x=0 scan.

A32.scope: Two sampled sections only (x=0, x=500 mm) at 20 C; the instrument measures chosen coordinates and never measured continuity between sections, so this is similarity between samples, not an axial map.
A32.statement: Hypothesis: the x=0 and x=500 mm sections show the same discrete contrast profile (100 out to ~20-62 um, 160 to the ~125 um surface, 20 outside), so the two-zone reading is not unique to one section, though axial continuity between them is unmeasured.

A33.scope: pulse_trace at state-0, 20 C, three injected pulses; per doc:calibration@1 only input and output times on common ideal clocks are recorded, path inside the sample is unobserved.
A33.statement: pulse_trace of S17 at 20 C gives input times [0, 100, 200] ns and output times [5.0, 105.0, 205.0] ns, i.e. a 5.0 ns transit for every pulse on the 1000 mm length.

A34.scope: Interpretation of one pulse_trace episode at 20 C; the fixture records only end-to-end times, so no internal subdivision is resolved and no temperature dependence is yet measured.
A34.statement: Hypothesis: at 20 C the end-to-end transit of S17 is a single reproducible 5.0 ns value independent of pulse index, which is consistent with a time-invariant end-to-end path but gives no information about internal radial zones.

QROOT.text: Исследуйте устройство образца S17 и его окружение. Сохраняйте найденные объекты, связи, основания и открытые вопросы. Различайте наблюдения, сообщения источников и гипотезы. Порядок, число объектов и глубина разбиения не заданы.

Q1.text: Chto opisano v doc:model-M7@1: est li tam vnutrennee ustroistvo ili sostav obyekta s markirovkoi M7, i otnositsya li on k obraztsu S17?

Q2.text: Kakie predely i usloviya izmerenii zadayut doc:calibration@1 i doc:references@1 dlya metodov observe, primenimykh k S17?

Q3.text: Yavlyaetsya li vneshnyaya markirovka M7 na S17 dostatochnym osnovaniem schitat S17 tipovym izdeliem M7, i mozhno li proverit material pokrytiya P-A na S17 instrumentom (material_response)?

Q4.text: Est li v doc:references@1 svoistva ili spravochnye otkliki materiala P-A, kotorye mozhno sopostavit s otklikom S17?

Q5.text: Sovpadaet li otklik materiala S17 (material_response pri 20 C) s etalonym otklikom P-A iz doc:references@1, i chto oznachaet tozhdestvo otklikov P-A i P-B dlya etoi proverki?

Q6.text: Kakie kanaly q1..q5, predely i usloviya izmerenii zadany v doc:calibration@1 dlya metodov observe, primenimykh k S17?

Q7.text: Kak sootnosyatsya abstraktnye edinitsy razresheniya radial_profile (shag 5, povtoryaemost 1) s zadanym diapazonom kkoordinat x=0 i 500 mm, i dostatochno li etogo razresheniya, chtoby razlichit vnutrennie granitsy v S17?

Q8.text: Mozhno li izmereniem material_response na S17 pri 20 C otlichit ego ot P-A/P-B, uchityvaya, chto etalonnye otkliki P-A i P-B sovpadayut i chto sovpadenie otklikov ne ustanavlivaet edinstvennosti sostava?

Q9.text: Kakoe vnutrennee stroenie S17: est li radialnye granitsy pri x=0 i x=500 mm, skolko ih i gde oni lokalizuyutsya v predelah razresheniya radial_profile?

Q10.text: Chto takoe U09: daet li material_response ego otklik, otlichaetsya li on ot etalonov doc:references@1 (vody, P-A, stekla), i sleduet li schitat U09 okruzhayushchei sredoi S17?

Q11.text: Можно ли уточнить положение внутренней границы в сечении x=0 (она попадает в интервал 20-62.4 um) и есть ли аналогичные границы в сечении x=500 mm?

Q12.text: Совпадает ли отклик внешней зоны S17 (material_response при x=0, r=90 um) с эталонным откликом полимера P-A из doc:references@1, и что это даёт для связи S17 с model:M7?

Q13.text: Какой материал у внутренней зоны S17 (contrast 100) при x=0: совпадает ли отклик при r=2 и r=20 um с каким-либо эталоном doc:references@1 (P-A, P-B, стекло, добавка GeO2), и отличается ли он от отклика внешней зоны?

Q14.text: Является ли стеклоподобный отклик внешней зоны следствием чистого материала, или это сумма откликов компонентов по условию смеси (массовые доли), учитывая эталон добавки GeO2 X [0.4,0.8,0.3,0.3,0.1]?

Q15.text: Является ли скачок контраста 100->160 при x=0 границей состава, если отклики обеих зон при 20 C совпадают со стеклом, или контраст отражает иную (не композиционную) неоднородность?

Q16.text: Что даёт pulse_trace при 20 C для S17: одно ли характерное время выхода на длине 1000 мм и меняется ли оно при 40 C, если материал по всей длине однороден?

Q17.text: Доступны ли ещё методы/условия, которые различают зоны S17, помимо совпадающих material_response, — например повторный radial_profile при 20 C или нагрев до 40 C и возврат к 20 C?

Q18.text: Если сечения x=0 и x=500 mm дают одинаковый контрастный профиль и одинаковый glass-подобный отклик, однороден ли образец по длине 1000 mm, и подтверждает ли это pulse_trace при 20 C, или вдоль длины есть изменение (например, при 40 C)?

Q19.text: Различаются ли контраст-100 и контраст-160 зоны S17 каким-либо иным доступным свойством, кроме совпадающего material_response (например, положением границы при более плотной сетке координат), или контраст не отражает состав?

Q20.text: Меняется ли задержка импульса S17 при 40 C (state-1) относительно измеренных 5.0 ns при 20 C, и возвращается ли она к 5.0 ns после охлаждения до 20 C (state-2) — то есть есть ли температурно-зависимый вклад в сквозное время?

QU1.reason: Catalog revision 1 exposed three documents; document contents still unread, so the root question stays open.

QU2.reason: Document read: it gives an external coating material and an example environment but no internal structure and no S17 reference, so the composition side is partly answered while S17 applicability stays unresolved.

QU3.reason: doc:references@1 does give a P-A reference response [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2] at 20 C, so the document side is answered; direct comparison still needs an S17 measurement.

QU4.reason: Reference-table conditions (20 C, channels q1..q5) are now known, but doc:calibration@1 is still unread, so instrument limits and channel definitions remain open.

QU5.reason: Both documents are now read: reference table gives 20 C and channels q1..q5, calibration gives tolerances and resolution, so the document half of the question is answered while S17 itself is still unmeasured.

QU6.reason: doc:calibration@1 gives tolerance 0.001/channel and abstract resolution units but never defines what q1..q5 physically are, so channel semantics stay unresolved even though declared limits are known.

QU7.reason: The overview resolves only the external outline (~125 um) and states smaller radial inhomogeneities are unresolved, so whether the abstract resolution suffices for internal boundaries is still untested.

QU8.reason: Overview gives label 'S17 / M7' and outer dimensions but no internal structure, so the document-to-sample question stays unresolved.

QU9.reason: A section at x=0 is now measured and shows at least one internal step, but the boundary is localized only between r=20 and 62.4 um and no section at x=500 mm or axial continuity exists yet.

QU10.reason: The sparse sampled coordinates make the transition fall in the gap 20-62.4 um, while the calibrated resolvable step is 5 units, so the declared resolution is not the binding limit for boundary placement here.

QU11.reason: Comparison made: the outer-zone response [0.9,0.2,0.1,0.05,0.05] equals glass standard G, not P-A [0.1,0.1,0.8,0.3,0.2], so no P-A match was found at x=0, r=90 um.

QU12.reason: The P-A coating hypothesis fails at the sampled outer point (glass-like response), yet the mark-to-model link and all other radii remain untested.

QU13.reason: First S17 material_response taken; it excludes P-A/P-B at r=90 um by matching glass, but the inner zone and other radii are still unmeasured.

QU14.reason: Inner-zone reading at r=2 um is now taken and equals the glass standard (and the outer-zone value), but r=20 um is still unsampled and no difference from the outer zone was found at the two tested radii.

QU15.reason: The P-A coating claim of doc:model-M7@1 is unsupported at both sampled radii (inner glass-like, outer glass-like), while the mark-to-model link and other radii remain untested.

QU16.reason: The x=0 section yields an internal contrast boundary whose two sides have so far identical material_response; the x=500 mm section and axial continuity are still unmeasured.

QU17.reason: The x=500 mm section is now measured and shows the same inner-boundary gap (20-62.4 um) as x=0, so the boundary cannot be placed more precisely at either section with this grid.

QU18.reason: Two sections now show the same discrete contrast pattern, but neither continuity between them nor any other section was measured, so the number and shape of internal zones stay open.

QU19.reason: The P-A coating claim remains unsupported where it has been tested (x=0, r=90 um, glass-like), and the identical x=500 mm profile gives no independent evidence for a P-A coating.

QU20.reason: pulse_trace at 20 C is now measured and gives a single constant 5.0 ns transit over 1000 mm; the 40 C comparison Q16 asks for is still outstanding.

QU21.reason: pulse_trace returns only a length-integrated input/output delay, so it neither confirms nor excludes axial changes; the identical x=0 and x=500 mm profiles still lack a between-section measurement.
